title: Beyond Relevance: Evaluate and Improve Retrievers on Perspective Awareness

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating retrieval results using perspective-neutral root queries on the balanced AllSides dataset to measure if models inherently favor specific political ideologies, such as disproportionately retrieving right-wing news articles.
Running perspective-neutral queries on the Perspectrum dataset to test if retrievers inherently favor extracting supporting documents over opposing/undermining documents in argumentative contexts.

Analyzing the retrieval success rates of location-specific queries on the AGNews dataset to measure if retrievers disproportionately favor retrieving news articles originating from certain countries (e.g., Brazil, Colombia) over others (e.g., France, Guatemala), despite a balanced corpus.
